title: Rhythm and audience response
summary: Rhythm is the heart of the music; she wants audiences moved and clapping.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: I have learned a lot from her. Once before, you and I talked a little about rhythm. In your way of singing, rhythm certainly seems to mean a very great deal. Rhythm is really the heart of the music, isn't it? That's right, that's right. Now, do you feel it helps when you have an audience that

respond even physically? Sure. I don't like to sing to these long hair that, that look like they, they, they can't be moved by music. I believe that any living soul should be moved by music in one way or the other. Everybody's not emotional as I am, but, uh, I like to see people that they, they, there was no more, a beautiful smile come on their face when they hear music. You don't mind their clapping their hands? Oh, no! No, no, no. I think they, they should.
